metrics.whyItMatters: Direction alone does not say whether a move is worth following. The same net return produced by a straight line and by a round trip demand different trades; efficiency is what separates them.
conflicts: Net move is negative but the path is inefficient — the sign is not evidence of a trend.
metrics.nextTrigger: only takes a side once the path gets cleaner — 0.20 of the moves in one direction rather than back and forth, against 0.13 now

metrics.label: Market Structure
metrics.confidenceBasis: 11 swing highs and 10 swing lows over 120 sessions. Confidence scales with how decisively both legs moved relative to the 13% range, and is capped at 75 because a two-pivot sequence is short.
metrics.explanation: IWM is printing lower highs and higher lows — compressing into a coil. Last swing high 283.38 vs prior 287.21; last swing low 275.75 vs prior 270.44.
metrics.whyItMatters: Structure is the only read that describes the SHAPE of a move rather than its size. Two markets up the same amount are different trades if one is making higher lows and the other keeps undercutting them — and structure is what a stop is placed against.
conflicts: Range is narrowing; structure resolves on the break, and gives no direction until it does.
metrics.nextTrigger: resolves on a close outside 275.75–283.38
